Support

We answer within one business day.

Get in touch

Email FILL: support email. Tell us your account email and, if it's about a booking, the event name and date — it saves a round trip.

Reporting objectionable content or a user

Every profile and message in the app has Report and Block. Blocking takes effect immediately: that person disappears from your search results, home feed, messages and reviews.

We review reports of objectionable content or abusive behaviour and act within 24 hours, including removing content and ejecting users. If it's urgent or involves someone's safety, email us directly and put URGENT in the subject.

Money questions

When does my vendor get paid?

Not when you pay. Your payment is held in escrow until both you and the vendor confirm the event happened, and the event date has passed. Each booking releases separately.

I need a refund

You can request a full refund from the booking within 24 hours of paying. After that, it's down to the vendor's own cancellation terms — talk to them in your event's group chat, and email us if you can't reach agreement.

Something went wrong at the event

Open the booking and choose Report a Problem. That freezes the money for that booking — and only that one — while we review it. Do this before confirming, because confirming starts the release.

I'm a vendor and I haven't been paid

Check three things: that you finished Stripe onboarding, that you checked in at the venue, and that the client has confirmed. Funds only move when both sides have confirmed and the date has passed. Still stuck? Email us with the event name.

Using the app

Check-in isn't working

Check-in uses your location to confirm you're at the venue, so it needs location permission and needs you to actually be there. If the booking has no venue on file, you'll get a simple Confirm button instead.

My price looks wrong

Rates can be per event, per person, per hour or per day. If a booking is missing its guest count or dates, you're looking at the rate rather than a total, and it can't be paid until that's filled in. Prices are frozen at payment — a vendor editing their listing afterwards doesn't change what you paid.

I want to sell on Jorna

Open Get started, add your vendor profile and services, then complete Stripe onboarding so you can be paid.

Delete my account

In the app: Settings → Delete your account. It's immediate. Some records tied to completed payments are retained where we're legally required to keep them — see the Privacy Policy.

Anything else

There's a walkthrough of how Jorna works — bundles, escrow, group chat, confirming — on the about page. If it's not covered there, email us.
